Donn Andre is a 1958 graduate of Hamilton College, a banjo player and lifelong fan and performer of Dixieland jazz. He is a member, with other Hamilton alums, of the Alumni All-Stars Jazz Band, one of the longest running ensembles in the nation. Donn makes his home in Derwood, Maryland, and has performed for many years with the Washington, DC-based band, the Federal Jazz Commission.
Donn was interviewed in Clinton, NY on June 6, 2009, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe, Director of the Jazz Archive here at Hamilton College. I am please to be meeting with Donn Andre today, class of ‘58.
Torch bearer for the Alumni Jazz Band and traditional jazz in general.
